Step.name: # (comment)
Step.Text: PURPOSE: Capture state for the current layout, store under key=layoutID inside the single $$LAYOUT.STATE JSON object.

Step.name: # (comment)
Step.Text: PARAM: layoutID (numeric, used as the JSON key). Caller must be on the layout being captured.

Step.name: # (comment)
Step.Text: DISPATCH: looks for a script named "Capture_<BaseLayoutName>". If missing (error 104), stores {} and returns silently.

Step.name: # (comment)
Step.Text: CONTRACT: per-layout capture scripts return a JSON object via Exit Script. Suggested keys: "tabs" (array of object names for Go to Object), "record_id" (PrimaryKey of active record), "found_set" (JSON array of PrimaryKey values -- populate via CustomList wrapped into JSON; Restore_ rebuilds the set by setting Globals::FoundSetKeys = JSONListValues(found_set) then Go to Related Records through <Entity>_byKeys). Layouts may add their own keys under "custom".

Step.name: Insert Text
Step.Text: STATE JSON CONTRACT (Capture_X returns / Restore_X consumes): { "tabs": [ "tabObjectName1", "panelObjectName2" ], // re-applied via Go to Object "record_id": "uuid-or-pk", // optional: go to this record (locate within rebuilt found set) "found_set": [ "uuid-a", "uuid-b", ... ], // optional: array of PrimaryKey values. Capture via CustomList(...) wrapped into JSON. Restore: Set Field [Globals::FoundSetKeys = JSONListValues(...)] then Go to Related Records [from <Entity>_byKeys via Globals]. O(1) regardless of set size. "custom": { ... } // layout-specific extras (sort criteria, scroll, etc.) }

Step.name: # (comment)
Step.Text: Try the layout-specific capture script. If it doesn't exist (104), store an empty state.

Step.name: # (comment)
Step.Text: No layout-specific capture exists -- store empty {} so reads return "{}" instead of "?" (missing key).
